items.title: vercel-labs/skills
items.summary:
The open agent skills tool - npx skillshttps://skills.shskills 
The CLI for the open agent skills ecosystem. 
 
Supports OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and 75 more. 
 
       
Install a Skill 
npx skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills
 
Use a Skill Without Installing 
Generate a prompt for one skill, or start a supported coding agent interactively: 
npx skills use vercel-labs/agent-skills@web-design-guidelines | claude
npx skills use vercel-labs/agent-skills --skill web-design-guidelines --

items.title: Meta’s Muse AI Agent Just Designed A Crypto-Specific SoC On The RISC-V Architecture For $2,000 To Transform The Thru Blockchain Into “The Fastest On Earth”
items.summary: Chip design is a patently laborious process, one that involves hefty use of a specialized suite of EDA tools. Even so, as is the case with so many other technical fields right now, AI agents might soon be able to realistically shrink the chip design pipeline to mere hours or days, as a semiconductor expert appears to have just done by designing a viable crypto-specific SoC on the RISC-V architecture using only Meta's Muse AI agent. items.title: Redesigning source control at Anthropic
items.summary:
Redesigning source control at Anthropic
Interesting piece from Anthropic describing why and how they built their own custom alternative to Git, based on the dramatic increase in rate of changes to their code after the past six months.

In May 2026, Anthropic averaged around 2,500 code changes merged per day; as of September, we merged over 30,000 per day.

items.title: Susan Thornton on US-China ties, post-midterms and averting a new balloon crisis
items.summary: Susan Thornton is a former American diplomat who for decades worked on US policy in Eurasia in the State Department before becoming acting assistant secretary of state for East Asian and Pacific affairs during the first Trump presidency. She is the director of the Forum on Asia-Pacific Security at the National Committee on American Foreign Policy and a senior fellow at the Paul Tsai China Centre, Yale Law School. She spoke to Orange Wang about keeping the lines of China-US communication...
